data.body:
PRODUCTION VALIDATION — the partition fix works against the real working set. This is the evidence
this ticket should close on, and it is deliberately NOT the "returns to green" AC.

## The run

Change 2657 merged to `main` as `084e753d30df`. The first hourly bridge pass after that merge:

    run 33947235995, conclusion SUCCESS
    step "Run reconciler":  05:29:26Z -> 05:55:37Z   =  26 min 11 s
    log: "Reconciling with bridge profile: live"
    log: NO BRIDGE_PAUSED line

## Why I checked rather than accepting the green

A bridge run reported SUCCESS earlier tonight (04:30) and it was a **paused no-op**: its reconciler
step ran **8 seconds** and printed `BRIDGE_PAUSED`. I read that green as recovery and filed a wrong
"the failure is intermittent" correction on this ticket as a result. So a green conclusion on this
workflow is not, by itself, evidence of anything.

The two are cleanly separable on the record:

| run | conclusion | reconciler step | BRIDGE_PAUSED |
|---|---|---|---|
| 04:30 | success | **8 s** | present — did nothing |
| 05:27 | success | **26 min 11 s** | absent — real pass |

26 minutes is the shape of a genuine pass (the pre-fix passes ran ~21 min against a smaller set).
A paused bridge cannot produce it.

## What this establishes

The reconciler completed a full pass against a REB working set measured at **1,388 active issues**
— above the `_ACLI_CEILING = 1200` that was raising `SilentTruncationError(reason="ceiling")` on
every pass at 01:33, 02:34 and 03:31. The `created`-window partition carried it.

That is exactly the AC6 replacement proposed on this ticket and endorsed: *a pass completing against
a working set at or above 1,388 with a provably complete snapshot*, which a pause or a no-op cannot
satisfy. The original wording — "the Reconcile Bridge workflow returns to green on its hourly
schedule" — is satisfied by a switched-off bridge, and was in fact satisfied by one tonight.

## Remaining before close

AC6 still needs rewording to the above before the criteria are ticked, since ticking the original
would be recording a green that a paused bridge could earn. That edit invalidates the plan-review
attestation (`stale-material`) and needs a fresh `review-plan`, which is queued behind current host
gate congestion — all 4 admission slots are in use and one of my own closes is already backing off
against them.
